description:
Stream your Windows PC to any device with native, GPU-accelerated remote desktop.

Remio Host turns your Windows PC into a streaming target that any Remio client (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows) can connect to over the local network or the internet.

Built from scratch with native WinUI 3 - no Electron, no browser wrappers. Full GPU-accelerated H.264/H.265 screen capture, loopback audio, multi-monitor support, drag-and-drop file transfer, clipboard sync, and gamepad passthrough. Runs as a Windows Service so it survives reboots and log-offs.

Includes built-in auto-updates via WinSparkle (EdDSA-signed end-to-end), so you always have the latest version with one click.
Remio Host 2.4.0 - sign in with email & password, plus fixes for a
crash when closing the app and a rare audio-device crash.

- Sign in with email & password: create a Remio account with just an
  email address and password - no Google or Apple account needed.
  Already signed in as a guest? Add an email and password to your
  existing setup and every pairing carries over.
- Fixed a crash when closing the app: quitting or restarting Remio
  Host could crash it at the very last moment - on some PCs on every
  single exit. The app now always closes cleanly.
- Fixed a rare crash when your audio device changes: plugging in
  headphones or switching speakers mid-session could, in unlucky
  timing, bring down the host. Audio now hands over reliably.
